subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Learn and say 12 extreme sports words.
Find which sports the WOW! Team talk about in the blog.
Sort sports by place and equipment and talk about sports you’d like to try.

tf.s: Diving is a sport you do under the water.
tf.why: Yes, divers go under the water with special equipment.

tf.s: Manar goes rock climbing at her local sports centre.
tf.why: Correct! She climbs at the sports centre.
Rosie doesn’t usually like extreme sports.

tf.s: Rosie was scared at first when horse riding because the horse looked so big.
tf.why: Right! The big horse scared her at first.

tf.s: Eric talks about go-karting in the WOW! Blog.
Paragliding is a sport with wheels.
tf.why: Paragliding is up high in the air.

tf.s: Abseiling means going down a rope on a cliff.
tf.why: Great! You go down a cliff on a rope.

tf.s: Caving is a sport you do in the sea.
tf.why: Caving is a sport you do in a cave.

tf.s: Beach volleyball is a water sport.
tf.why: Beach volleyball is a sand sport.

tf.s: Mountain biking means riding a bike on city roads.
tf.why: Mountain biking is riding a bike on mountain paths.

boxes.q: Which sport do you do on a board on big waves?
boxes.why: Surfboarding is on waves in the sea.

boxes.q: Which sport needs a small fast car on a track?
Who doesn’t usually like extreme sports?
boxes.why: Rosie said she doesn’t usually like them.
Paragliders fly high in the air.
Motor racing uses cars with wheels.

boxes.q: Which sport is in the water, pulled by a boat?
boxes.why: A boat pulls you on skis.

boxes.q: Which sport do you do on sand dunes?

boxes.why: We stress the GLI in paragliding.

hunt.q: Down a rope on a cliff

mcq.q: Which sports does Ali talk about?
o: Water skiing, surfboarding, paragliding and diving

mcq.q: Why was Rosie scared at first?
mcq.why: Rosie was scared of the big horse.

mcq.q: Which group of sports all need something with wheels?
mcq.why: Karts, cars and bikes have wheels.

mcq.q: Which group of sports are usually up high?
mcq.why: These sports happen high above the ground.

mcq.q: Clues: water, a boat pulls you, skis. Which sport is it?
mcq.why: A boat pulls you on skis on the water.

mcq.q: Choose the best answer to “Would you like to try paragliding?”
o: Yes, I played it yesterday at school.
mcq.why: A good answer gives a clear reason.

mcq.q: Which sentence tells where and who with?
o: I play football in the park with my brother.
mcq.why: It says the place (park) and the person (brother).

mcq.q: Which sport is the odd one out?
Which sports probably need a helmet?
mcq.why: Helmets protect your head in climbing and racing.

mcq.q: Rosie doesn’t usually like extreme sports, but she tried horse riding. What does this show?
o: You can try something new even if you feel scared.
Horse riding is not a sport.
